description: Labelled (session body, search query) pairs for calibrating LORE_SEMANTIC_MAX_DISTANCE (issue #92), measured 2026-10-14. Session texts are shaped like the vec0 embed input: title plus message lines, i.e. the same body written to search_index. sqlite-vec's default metric on session_embeddings is L2 over unit-normalised bge-small vectors, so distance = sqrt(2 - 2*cosine).

pairs.session:
Fix pgbouncer connection limits
user: our API pods exhaust postgres connections under load
assistant: raise pgbouncer pool_size to 80 and set default_pool_size to 20, then restart the sidecar
user: does that survive a pod rollout
assistant: yes, clients reconnect and the server never sees more than the pool_size we configured
pairs.query: how to configure pgbouncer pooling for the api
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Set up wake-on-lan for the TrueNAS test runner
user: the godot runner VM is powered off again
assistant: enable Wake-on-LAN on the interface in the TrueNAS UI, then wake it with etherwake before any remote check
user: and never shut it down
assistant: correct, the runbook says wake it, never power it off, because the Android farm shares the host
pairs.query: wake the test runner over the network
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Client-side email validation on login
user: users submit broken addresses through the login form
assistant: add a pattern check on blur before submit, but keep the server-side validation as the authority
user: what about typo domains
assistant: suggest a correction but never block, the mail server may still accept it
pairs.query: validate email address in the login form
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Restic backup retention
user: how long do we keep nightly backups on the NAS
assistant: 14 daily, 8 weekly and 4 monthly snapshots, the repository is encrypted with the key from the vault
user: and restore
assistant: restore into a scratch directory first and verify counts before touching anything live
pairs.query: restic retention policy for nightly backups
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Review gate merge policy
user: when does a commit actually reach main
assistant: the gate pushes a review ref, runs both reviewers in parallel and fast-forwards only when nobody returns BLOCK
user: what if one reviewer blocks four times
assistant: stop looping, report the finding instead, the owner never sees a menu
pairs.query: at what point is a commit merged to main
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Flask secret key in production
user: sessions die whenever the container restarts
assistant: set FLASK_SECRET_KEY in the environment, without it the app signs cookies with an ephemeral key
user: where does it come from
assistant: from the deployment environment, never committed to the repository
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
SQLite WAL during sync
user: the web ui reports database is locked while a sync runs
assistant: WAL journal mode with a 5000 ms busy timeout lets readers and one writer overlap
user: and the memory write
assistant: it can overlap a sync too, the busy timeout covers it
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Migration safety rules
user: can we run the new migration against the live archive
assistant: never without a verified backup, test on a copy made with copy_sqlite_with_sidecars first
user: and if counts differ
assistant: stop and report, any difference is a failure, not something to smooth over
pairs.query: safe way to run a database migration
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Kitchen renovation planning
user: the electrician needs lead time for the new sockets
assistant: two weeks, and the plan puts three outlets behind the workbench and one above the sink
user: and the timeline
assistant: demolition in November, cabinets the week after
pairs.query: when does the kitchen renovation start
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Hash based routing decision
user: why do we use hash urls instead of history mode
assistant: the app must work from file:// and from a static host without a rewrite rule
user: any downside
assistant: the hash shows up in links, everything else behaves the same
pairs.query: reason for hash based client routing
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Nightly job timeout failure
user: the nightly window failed three days in a row
assistant: GNU timeout rejected the duration 4h55m, it only accepts plain seconds or 4h55m without the suffix m
user: fix
assistant: pass seconds, and compare quota reset timestamps at stable precision before retrying
pairs.query: why did the nightly job keep failing
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Content security policy nonces
user: the policy blocks our inline bootstrap script
assistant: give every script tag a per-response nonce and drop inline handlers entirely, the delegated wiring already exists
user: and external cdn
assistant: allow-list only the fonts origin, everything else stays local
pairs.query: how are nonces issued for script tags
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Docker image hardening
user: what do we require before an image ships
assistant: pinned digest base, non-root user, COPY instead of ADD, and a healthcheck for production
user: and the compose file
assistant: no private dns, no external network, least privilege mounts documented
pairs.label: related

pairs.session:
Pruning old sessions
user: what happens to sessions older than the window
assistant: pruning keeps two hundred sessions in the index, older ones move to cold storage and drop out of search
user: can we get them back
assistant: yes, from the archive, they are just not indexed anymore
pairs.query: what happens to very old sessions
pairs.label: related
